SELECT
  r.id,
  CASE
    WHEN r.rs_number IS NOT NULL AND r.rs_number != ''
    THEN 'RS-' || r.rs_letter || r.rs_number
    ELSE 'TMP-RS-' || r.draft_rs_number
  END AS rs_number,
  r.purpose,
  r.status,
  r.date_required,
  r.created_at,
  u.username AS created_by,
  c.name AS company,
  d.name AS department,
  p.name AS project
FROM
  requisitions AS r
LEFT JOIN
  users AS u ON r.created_by = u.id
LEFT JOIN
  companies AS c ON r.company_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN
  departments AS d ON r.department_id = d.id
LEFT JOIN
  projects AS p ON r.project_id = p.id
WHERE
  r.status = ANY('{${status_var:csv}}')
ORDER BY
  r.id DESC;

SELECT *
FROM (
    -- Canvass Events
    SELECT
        h.created_at AS event_time,
        h.requisition_id,
        'Canvass' AS event_type,
        'Canvassed item "' || h.item || '" from ' || h.supplier AS description,
        h.status,
        h.canvass_number AS reference_no,
        al.action_type,
        al.url,
        al.username
    FROM
        requisition_canvass_histories h
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            a.action_type,
            a.metadata->>'url' AS url,
            a.metadata->'userDetails'->>'username' AS username
        FROM audit_logs a
        WHERE a.created_at BETWEEN h.created_at - '1 second'::interval AND h.created_at + '1 second'::interval AND a.module = 'canvass'
        ORDER BY abs(extract(epoch from h.created_at) - extract(epoch from a.created_at))
        LIMIT 1
    ) al ON true
    UNION ALL

    -- Delivery Events
    SELECT
        h.created_at AS event_time,
        h.requisition_id,
        'Delivery' AS event_type,
        'Delivered ' || h.quantity_delivered || ' units from ' || h.supplier AS description,
        h.status,
        h.dr_number AS reference_no,
        al.action_type,
        al.url,
        al.username
    FROM
        requisition_delivery_histories h
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            a.action_type,
            a.metadata->>'url' AS url,
            a.metadata->'userDetails'->>'username' AS username
        FROM audit_logs a
        WHERE a.created_at BETWEEN h.created_at - '1 second'::interval AND h.created_at + '1 second'::interval AND a.module = 'delivery'
        ORDER BY abs(extract(epoch from h.created_at) - extract(epoch from a.created_at))
        LIMIT 1
    ) al ON true
    UNION ALL

    -- -- Item Events (This section is modified with your new logic)
    -- SELECT
    --     h.created_at AS event_time,
    --     h.requisition_id,
    --     'Item Added' AS event_type,
    --     'Requested ' || h.quantity_requested || ' units of "' || h.item || '"' AS description,
    --     CASE
    --         WHEN r.status IS NOT NULL AND r.status != '' THEN r.status
    --         WHEN r.draft_rs_number IS NOT NULL AND r.draft_rs_number != '' THEN 'Draft'
    --         ELSE NULL
    --     END AS status,
    --     CASE    -- Use your conditional logic to build the reference number
    --         WHEN r.rs_number IS NOT NULL AND r.rs_number != ''
    --         THEN 'RS-' || r.company_code || r.rs_letter || r.rs_number
    --         ELSE 'TMP-RS-' || r.draft_rs_number
    --     END AS reference_no,
    --     al.action_type,
    --     al.url,
    --     al.username
    -- FROM
    --     requisition_item_histories h
    -- LEFT JOIN 
    --     requisitions r ON h.requisition_id = r.id
    -- LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    --     SELECT
    --         a.action_type,
    --         a.metadata->>'url' AS url,
    --         a.metadata->'userDetails'->>'username' AS username
    --     FROM audit_logs a
    --     WHERE a.created_at BETWEEN h.created_at - '1 second'::interval AND h.created_at + '1 second'::interval AND a.module LIKE 'requisition%' AND a.action_type = 'insert'
    --     ORDER BY abs(extract(epoch from h.created_at) - extract(epoch from a.created_at))
    --     LIMIT 1
    -- ) al ON true
    -- UNION ALL

    -- Order Events
    SELECT
        h.created_at AS event_time,
        h.requisition_id,
        'Order' AS event_type,
        'PO created for ' || h.supplier AS description,
        h.status,
        h.po_number AS reference_no,
        al.action_type,
        al.url,
        al.username
    FROM
        requisition_order_histories h
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            a.action_type,
            a.metadata->>'url' AS url,
            a.metadata->'userDetails'->>'username' AS username
        FROM audit_logs a
        WHERE a.created_at BETWEEN h.created_at - '1 second'::interval AND h.created_at + '1 second'::interval AND a.module = 'order'
        ORDER BY abs(extract(epoch from h.created_at) - extract(epoch from a.created_at))
        LIMIT 1
    ) al ON true
    UNION ALL

    -- Payment Events
    SELECT
        h.created_at AS event_time,
        h.requisition_id,
        'Payment' AS event_type,
        'PR created for ' || h.supplier AS description,
        h.status,
        'PR-' || h.pr_number AS reference_no,
        al.action_type,
        al.url,
        al.username
    FROM
        requisition_payment_histories h
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            a.action_type,
            a.metadata->>'url' AS url,
            a.metadata->'userDetails'->>'username' AS username
        FROM audit_logs a
        WHERE a.created_at BETWEEN h.created_at - '1 second'::interval AND h.created_at + '1 second'::interval AND a.module = 'payment'
        ORDER BY abs(extract(epoch from h.created_at) - extract(epoch from a.created_at))
        LIMIT 1
    ) al ON true
    UNION ALL

    -- Return Events
    SELECT
        h.created_at AS event_time,
        h.requisition_id,
        'Return' AS event_type,
        'Returned ' || h.quantity_returned || ' units of "' || h.item || '"' AS description,
        h.status,
        h.dr_number AS reference_no,
        al.action_type,
        al.url,
        al.username
    FROM
        requisition_return_histories h
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            a.action_type,
            a.metadata->>'url' AS url,
            a.metadata->'userDetails'->>'username' AS username
        FROM audit_logs a
        WHERE a.created_at BETWEEN h.created_at - '1 second'::interval AND h.created_at + '1 second'::interval AND a.module = 'return'
        ORDER BY abs(extract(epoch from h.created_at) - extract(epoch from a.created_at))
        LIMIT 1
    ) al ON true
) AS all_histories
WHERE 
    all_histories.status = ANY('{${status_var:csv}}')
ORDER BY
    event_time DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) as "Pending Requisitions" FROM requisitions WHERE status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL';

SELECT
  status,
  COUNT(id) AS "total"
FROM
  requisitions
GROUP BY
  status
ORDER BY
  "total" DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) as "New Requisitions" FROM requisitions WHERE status = 'DRAFT' AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours';
